roadmap.name: 9-Month Data Engineering, AI & Full-Stack Mastery
roadmap.description: Rigorous 3-hours/day roadmap covering SQL, Advanced DBs, Python DE, Stats & Anomaly, Forecasting, LLMs & Text-to-SQL, AI Agents & Airflow, Go Backend, React, and DevOps.

months.title: SQL Foundations
months.description: Relational query language fundamentals, aggregations, filtering, multi-table joins, subqueries, CTEs, and string/date manipulation.
months.goal: Gain absolute fluency in writing, debugging, and combining SQL queries from single table aggregations to complex CTE joins.

months.title: Advanced SQL + Database Engineering
months.description: Window functions, execution plans, indexing strategies, recursive queries, stored procedures, transactions, ACID, and query optimization.
months.goal: Master analytics query design, window partitioning, and database engine internals for high-throughput enterprise pipelines.

months.title: Python + Data Engineering
months.description: Python OOP, robust file handling, JSON/APIs, typing, NumPy, Pandas transformations, vectorization, and Postgres ETL pipelines.
months.goal: Construct resilient data ingestion and ETL scripts handling messy real-world schemas and automated loads.

months.title: Statistics + Data Quality + Anomaly Detection
months.description: Descriptive stats, distributions, Z-score, IQR, referential checks, moving averages, and unsupervised Isolation Forests for anomaly detection.
months.goal: Build an automated data reliability engine that validates freshness, volume, distribution drift, and outliers.

months.title: Forecasting + Analytics
months.description: Time series decomposition, stationarity, ARIMA, exponential smoothing, moving averages, train-test splits, and forecast accuracy metrics (MAPE, RMSE).
months.goal: Design a predictive forecasting service that cleans historical telemetry and delivers actionable demand projections.

months.title: AI / LLM / Text-to-SQL
months.description: LLM APIs, prompt engineering, structured JSON outputs, function calling, hallucination mitigation, semantic schema validation, and Text-to-SQL.
months.goal: Build an enterprise Natural-Language-to-SQL engine with schema injection, AST validation, and safety guardrails.

months.title: AI Agents + Pipeline Orchestration
months.description: Autonomous planning, tool calling, state recovery, human-in-the-loop validation, Apache Airflow DAGs, tasks, sensor dependencies, and monitoring.
months.goal: Orchestrate an 8-stage enterprise autonomous data pipeline with retries, alerts, and agentic error recovery.

months.title: Go Backend + React Frontend
months.description: Idiomatic Go REST APIs, middleware, JWT auth, Postgres connection pooling, goroutines, combined with modern React, TypeScript, and charts.
months.goal: Develop a high-performance full-stack data portal capable of serving sub-millisecond API responses to an interactive React UI.

months.title: Production + DevOps
months.description: Docker containerization, Compose orchestration, volume persistence, networking, CI/CD GitHub Actions, Linux administration, and cloud deployment.
months.goal: Deploy the unified multi-tier data architecture to production cloud containers with monitoring and health checks.

topics.name: SELECT & FROM

topics.name: WHERE & Comparison Operators

topics.name: ORDER BY & LIMIT / DISTINCT
topics.description: Ordering result sets, deduplicating records, and pagination.

topics.name: GROUP BY & Aggregations
topics.description: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, and HAVING filter conditions.

topics.name: INNER, LEFT, RIGHT & FULL JOINs
topics.description: Relational algebra joins, cardinality, join keys, and multi-table joins.

topics.name: Subqueries & CTEs
topics.description: Common Table Expressions (WITH clauses), correlated subqueries, and modular query design.

topics.name: SQL Window Functions
topics.description: ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, LAG, LEAD, and OVER(PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY).

topics.name: Recursive CTEs & Hierarchies
topics.description: Recursive queries for tree traversal, organizational charts, and graph pathfinding.

topics.name: Query Plans & B-Tree Indexing
topics.description: EXPLAIN ANALYZE, index scan vs sequential scan, composite indexes, and index selectivity.

topics.name: Transactions & ACID Guarantees
topics.description: Isolation levels, dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, phantom reads, and WAL logging.

topics.name: Python OOP & Type Hints
topics.description: Classes, dunder methods, inheritance, type annotations, and custom exception handling.

topics.name: Pandas DataFrames & Vectorization
topics.description: read_csv, read_json, merge, groupby, apply, fillna, drop_duplicates, and vectorized logic.

topics.name: Descriptive Stats & Z-Score / IQR
topics.description: Mean, variance, standard deviation, distributions, outlier detection with Z-score and IQR.

topics.name: Isolation Forests & Drift Detection
topics.description: Unsupervised outlier detection, schema drift, referential completeness, and freshness monitoring.

topics.name: Time Series Decomposition & ARIMA
topics.description: Trend, seasonality, noise, stationarity tests (ADF), differencing, and ARIMA parameter tuning.

topics.name: LLM APIs, Prompting & Function Calling
topics.description: Prompt structuring, JSON schema enforcement, tool invocation, token management, and grounding.

topics.name: Schema-Aware Text-to-SQL & Validation
topics.description: Database catalog extraction, schema grounding, AST verification, and execution guardrails.

topics.name: Apache Airflow DAGs & Operators
topics.description: DAG authoring, PythonOperator, BashOperator, sensor tasks, XComs, scheduling, and SLAs.

topics.name: Autonomous Agents & Human-in-the-Loop
topics.description: ReAct patterns, planning loops, error diagnosis, automated recovery, and state persistence.

topics.name: Go HTTP, Routing & Goroutines
topics.description: net/http, chi router, structs, JSON serialization, middleware, and concurrent worker pools.

topics.name: React 19, TypeScript & Charts
topics.description: Component state, custom data hooks, loading states, error boundaries, and Recharts integration.

topics.name: Docker, Multi-Stage Builds & Compose
topics.description: Writing efficient Dockerfiles, layer caching, bridge networks, volumes, and multi-container Compose.

topics.name: GitHub Actions CI/CD & Cloud Run
topics.description: Automated test pipelines, secret injection, container registry pushes, and zero-downtime deploys.
